def sos_pieces(ctx, N):
    N=sp.sympify(N)
    L=setup.L
    astar=setup.f.grad(ctx['x_star'])
    pieces=[]
    for i in range(1,int(N)+1):
        xprev,x=ctx[f'x_{i-1}'],ctx[f'x_{i}']
        aprev,a=setup.f.grad(xprev),setup.f.grad(x)
        s=setup.g.grad(x)
        c1=N/((2*N+1-i)*(2*N-i)*L)
        u1=sp.Rational(i,2)/N*a+(2*N-i)/(2*N)*aprev-astar
        c2=(sp.Integer(i-1)/(2*N-i)*(2*N+2)/(2*N+1)+2*N/((2*N-i)**2*(2*N+1)))/(2*L)
        u2=aprev+s-L/(2*N+1-i)*(xprev-ctx['x_star'])
        c3=sp.Integer(i)/(2*N+1-i)*2*N/(2*N+1)/(2*L)
        u3=(2*N+1)/(2*N)*(a+s)-(aprev+s)/(2*N)-L/(2*N-i)*(x-ctx['x_star'])
        pieces.extend([(i,'u1',c1,u1),(i,'u2',c2,u2),(i,'u3',c3,u3)])
    return pieces

def inventory(ctx, pb):
    entries = [(c, 'initial', None, None) for c in pb.init_conditions]
    for owner in ctx.func_to_triplets:
        groups = ctx.get_constraint_data(owner)
        entries.extend((c, 'interpolation', str(owner), str(group))
                       for group, constraints in groups.sc_dict.items() for c in constraints)
        entries.extend((c, 'interpolation', str(owner), str(group)) for group, c in groups.psd_dict.items())
    return entries

def residual_of(c):
    residual = c.lhs-c.rhs
    return -residual if c.cmp in (Comparator.GE,Comparator.SEQ) else residual

def verify(data, dense_value, decomposition=None):
    ctx,pb,_ = setup.get_pep_setup(data['N'],json.loads(data['params_json']))
    if data['relaxed_constraints']:
        pb.set_relaxed_constraints(data['relaxed_constraints'])
    for func in ctx.func_to_triplets:
        func.get_interpolation_constraints(ctx)
    entries = inventory(ctx,pb)
    assert set(data['constraint_metadata']) == {c.name for c,*_ in entries}
    assert data['basis_vectors'] == [str(v) for v in ctx.basis_vectors()]
    assert data['basis_scalars'] == [str(v) for v in ctx.basis_scalars()]
    pm = pf.ExpressionManager(ctx,resolve_parameters={'L':sp.S.One,'R':sp.S.One})
    weighted=pf.Scalar.zero()
    vals=[]
    for c,*_ in entries:
        value=data['named_dual_values'][c.name]
        if c.name in pb.relaxed_constraints:
            assert value is None
            continue
        assert isinstance(c,pf.ScalarConstraint), 'This PGM sample has only scalar constraints'
        weighted += float(value)*(pf.Scalar.zero()+residual_of(c))
        if c.cmp != Comparator.EQ:
            vals.append(float(value))
    basis=ctx.basis_vectors()
    S=np.asarray(data['S_matrix'],dtype=float)
    S_scalar=sum((float(S[i,j])*basis[i]*basis[j] for i,j in np.ndindex(S.shape)),pf.Scalar.zero())
    checked=pm.eval_scalar(pb.performance_metric-data['opt_value']-weighted+S_scalar)
    def ma(v):
        return float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(v,dtype=float)),initial=0.0))
    reconstruction=S if decomposition is None else np.asarray(decomposition['ell_coords']).T@np.asarray(decomposition['D'])@np.asarray(decomposition['ell_coords'])
    residuals=dict(identity_gram_max_abs=ma(checked.inner_prod_coords),identity_func_max_abs=ma(checked.func_coords),identity_offset_abs=ma(checked.offset),
                   S_reconstruction_max_abs=ma(reconstruction-S),dense_relaxed_gap=abs(data['opt_value']-dense_value),
                   minimum_scalar_inequality_dual=min(vals,default=0.0),minimum_S_eigenvalue=float(np.linalg.eigvalsh((S+S.T)/2).min()),
                   minimum_matrix_inequality_eigenvalue=0.0,candidate_rate_gap=abs(data['opt_value']-1/(4*data['N'])))
    passed=data['certificate_provenance']['solver_status']=='optimal' and np.all(np.isfinite(S)) and np.allclose(S,S.T,atol=1e-6,rtol=0)
    passed=passed and all(residuals[k]<=1e-5 for k in ('identity_gram_max_abs','identity_func_max_abs','identity_offset_abs','dense_relaxed_gap','candidate_rate_gap'))
    passed=passed and np.allclose(reconstruction,S,atol=1e-4,rtol=1e-5) and residuals['minimum_scalar_inequality_dual']>=-1e-6 and residuals['minimum_S_eigenvalue']>=-1e-6
    return dict(tolerances=TOL,residuals=residuals,passed=bool(passed)),ctx,pb,checked

def replay(certificate):
    digest=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps({key:certificate[key] for key in CERTIFICATE_KEYS},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode()).hexdigest()
    assert digest==certificate['certificate_id']
    assert certificate['closed_form_search']['completed']
    assert certificate['certificate_provenance']['pep_type']=='primal'
    assert Path(pf.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(APPROVED)
    for name,expected in certificate['certificate_provenance']['source_hashes'].items():
        path=(ROOT/name).resolve()
        assert path.is_relative_to(ROOT)
        assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
    checks,ctx,pb,_=verify(certificate,certificate['opt_value'],certificate['numerical_decomposition'])
    assert checks['passed']
    assert certificate['N']==certificate['N_verify']
    assert certificate['S_row_names']==certificate['basis_vectors']==certificate['S_col_names']
    entries=inventory(ctx,pb)
    assert len(entries)==len({c.name for c,*_ in entries})
    assert set(certificate['named_dual_values'])==set(certificate['constraint_metadata'])
    for c,origin,owner,group in entries:
        expected=dict(origin=origin,owner=owner,group=group,kind='scalar',comparator=c.cmp.value,shape=[],relaxed=c.name in pb.relaxed_constraints)
        assert certificate['constraint_metadata'][c.name]==expected
    assert certificate['normalization']['tau_name']==certificate['tau_name']=='initial_condition'
    assert abs(certificate['tau_sol']-certificate['named_dual_values']['initial_condition'])<=1e-6
    assert abs(certificate['normalization']['bound_value']-certificate['opt_value'])<=1e-5
    return ctx,pb,checks

    L=setup.L

        aprev,a=setup.f.grad(xprev),setup.f.grad(x)
        s=setup.g.grad(x)
        c1=N/((2*N+1-i)*(2*N-i)*L)
        u1=sp.Rational(i,2)/N*a+(2*N-i)/(2*N)*aprev-astar
        c2=(sp.Integer(i-1)/(2*N-i)*(2*N+2)/(2*N+1)+2*N/((2*N-i)**2*(2*N+1)))/(2*L)
        u2=aprev+s-L/(2*N+1-i)*(xprev-ctx['x_star'])
        c3=sp.Integer(i)/(2*N+1-i)*2*N/(2*N+1)/(2*L)
        u3=(2*N+1)/(2*N)*(a+s)-(aprev+s)/(2*N)-L/(2*N-i)*(x-ctx['x_star'])
        pieces.extend([(i,'u1',c1,u1),(i,'u2',c2,u2),(i,'u3',c3,u3)])

def aligned_squares(certificate, ctx):
    S=np.asarray(certificate['S_matrix'],dtype=float)
    values,vectors=np.linalg.eigh((S+S.T)/2)
    assert values.min()>=0, 'This exact numerical alignment requires a PSD saved S'
    sqrt_S=(vectors*np.sqrt(values))@vectors.T
    decomposition=certificate['numerical_decomposition']
    D=np.asarray(decomposition['D'],dtype=float)
    E=np.asarray(decomposition['ell_coords'],dtype=float)
    assert np.array_equal(D,np.diag(np.diag(D))) and np.diag(D).min()>=0
    supplied_factors=np.sqrt(np.diag(D))[:,None]*E
    Q,_=polar(supplied_factors@sqrt_S)
    aligned=Q@sqrt_S
    assert np.allclose(aligned.T@aligned,S,atol=1e-10,rtol=0)
    basis=ctx.basis_vectors()
    pieces={label:sum((float(coef)*v for coef,v in zip(row,basis)),pf.Vector.zero())**2
            for label,row in zip(decomposition['piece_labels'],aligned)}
    return pieces,dict(method='polar alignment of supplied factors to saved S',
                      factors=aligned.tolist(),factor_max_change=float(np.max(abs(aligned-supplied_factors))),
                      reconstruction_max_abs=float(np.max(abs(aligned.T@aligned-S))))

def construct(certificate, variant='canonical'):
    ctx,pb,certificate_checks=replay(certificate)
    n=certificate['N']
    pm=pf.ExpressionManager(ctx,resolve_parameters={'L':sp.S.One,'R':sp.S.One})
    group_terms={}
    term_assignment={}
    for constraint,origin,owner,group in inventory(ctx,pb):
        value=certificate['named_dual_values'][constraint.name]
        if origin=='initial' or value is None:
            continue
        group_terms[constraint.name]=float(value)*residual_of(constraint)
        left,right=constraint.name.split(':')[1].split(',')
        j=int(right[2:])
        if left=='x_star' and j==0:
            term_assignment[constraint.name]=-1
        else:
            term_assignment[constraint.name]=j-1
    S_piece_terms={f'{family}_{i}':coefficient*vector**2 for i,family,coefficient,vector in sos_pieces(ctx,n)}
    if variant == 'polar-aligned':
        S_piece_terms, alignment = aligned_squares(certificate, ctx)
    elif variant == 'blend-3/10':
        aligned_pieces, alignment = aligned_squares(certificate, ctx)
        S_piece_terms = {name:sp.Rational(7,10)*piece+sp.Rational(3,10)*aligned_pieces[name] for name,piece in S_piece_terms.items()}
    S_assignment={name:int(name.split('_')[1])-1 for name in S_piece_terms}
    lyap=[pf.Scalar.zero()]
    partial_sum=sum((term for name,term in group_terms.items() if term_assignment[name]==-1),pf.Scalar.zero())
    for k in range(n):
        partial_sum+=sum((term for name,term in group_terms.items() if term_assignment[name]==k),pf.Scalar.zero())
        partial_sum-=sum((term for name,term in S_piece_terms.items() if S_assignment[name]==k),pf.Scalar.zero())
        lyap.append(partial_sum)
    evaluated=[pm.eval_scalar(v) for v in lyap]
    spectra=[np.linalg.svd(np.asarray(v.inner_prod_coords,dtype=float),compute_uv=False) for v in evaluated]
    ranks=[int(np.sum(s>1e-4)) for s in spectra]
    basis=ctx.basis_vectors()
    S=np.asarray(certificate['S_matrix'],dtype=float)
    S_scalar=sum((float(S[i,j])*basis[i]*basis[j] for i,j in np.ndindex(S.shape)),pf.Scalar.zero())
    checks={}
    for label,expression in [('coverage',lyap[n]-(sum(group_terms.values(),pf.Scalar.zero())-S_scalar)),('pieces',sum(S_piece_terms.values(),pf.Scalar.zero())-S_scalar)]:
        value=pm.eval_scalar(expression)
        residual=max(float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(arr,dtype=float)),initial=0)) for arr in (value.inner_prod_coords,value.func_coords,np.asarray(value.offset)))
        checks[label]=residual
        assert residual<=1e-5
    min_piece_eigen=0.0
    for piece in S_piece_terms.values():
        value=pm.eval_scalar(piece)
        M=np.asarray(value.inner_prod_coords,dtype=float)
        min_piece_eigen=min(min_piece_eigen,float(np.linalg.eigvalsh((M+M.T)/2).min()))
        assert np.max(abs(value.func_coords),initial=0)<=1e-5 and abs(value.offset)<=1e-5
    assert min_piece_eigen>=-1e-6
    increment_errors=[]
    for k in range(n):
        steps=(-1,0) if k==0 else (k,)
        inc=sum((term for name,term in group_terms.items() if term_assignment[name] in steps),pf.Scalar.zero())
        inc-=sum((term for name,term in S_piece_terms.items() if S_assignment[name] in steps),pf.Scalar.zero())
        value=pm.eval_scalar(lyap[k+1]-lyap[k]-inc)
        error=max(float(np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(arr,dtype=float)),initial=0)) for arr in (value.inner_prod_coords,value.func_coords,np.asarray(value.offset)))
        increment_errors.append(error)
        assert error<=1e-5
    checks.update(minimum_piece_eigenvalue=min_piece_eigen,maximum_increment_error=max(increment_errors),boundary_constraints=[],boundary_S=[],omitted_constraints=[])
    observation=dict(N=n,certificate_id=certificate['certificate_id'],recipe_id=variant,rank_profile=ranks,
                     rank_convention=dict(tolerance=1e-4,scaling='absolute, unscaled native Gram coordinates',coordinate_order='context basis creation order'),
                     singular_values=[s.tolist() for s in spectra],rank_credible=all(not np.any((s>=5e-5)&(s<=2e-4)) for s in spectra),
                     certificate_checked=True,grouping_checked=True,checks=checks)
    return dict(ctx=ctx,pb=pb,pm=pm,lyap=lyap,observation=observation,term_assignment=term_assignment,S_assignment=S_assignment,
                group_terms=group_terms,S_piece_terms=S_piece_terms,certificate_checks=certificate_checks)
